title: Lingering Thread
text: Process one Clock through advanced condensation to obtain a Lingering Thread.
Writes Delay. The first converts Harm to Poison I and Healing to Regeneration I for 40 seconds. Another adds 60 seconds. Enhancement can still raise their effect levels.
For dissociation, it removes creature damage without changing block harvesting. For construction, each Delay doubles crystal lifetime and creature lock duration.
